import subprocess, json, pathlib, sys, hashlib, os
root = pathlib.Path('/home/name/Documents/420-EMBDX/A')
log = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('EDIT_DELETE_RAW_LOG', root / 'logs/commands/edit-delete-line-execution.log'))
ledger = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('EDIT_DELETE_LEDGER', root / 'logs/commands/edit-delete-line-evidence.json'))
def run(label, command, cwd=root, expected=0, timeout=240):
    p = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, shell=isinstance(command,str), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=timeout)
    with log.open('ab') as f:
        f.write(('\n=== '+label+' ===\nCWD: '+str(cwd)+'\nCOMMAND: '+str(command)+'\nSTATUS: '+str(p.returncode)+'\nSTDOUT:\n').encode())
        f.write(p.stdout); f.write(b'\nSTDERR:\n'); f.write(p.stderr)
    data = json.loads(ledger.read_text()) if ledger.exists() else {'head':'2c6f01ce87fe6d8f9f8b1bd6f38a717d7ed5233d','commands':[]}
    data['commands'].append({'label':label,'command':command,'cwd':str(cwd),'status':p.returncode,'expected':expected,'stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(),'stderr_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.stderr).hexdigest()})
    ledger.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(label, 'status',p.returncode,'expected',expected)
    print((p.stdout+p.stderr).decode(errors='replace')[-4500:])
    if expected is not None and p.returncode != expected: raise RuntimeError(label)
    return p
if __name__ == '__main__':
    run(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2],expected=int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 0)

    print('COURSE',course)

      ('argv', source.replace('arg_parse(argc, copy, table)','arg_parse(argc, argv, table)'), b'argv pointer preservation failed'),
      ('getopt', source.replace('optind = saved_optind;', '(void)saved_optind;'), b'getopt preservation failed'),
      ('no-rename', source.replace('rename(name, path)', '0'), b'source content mismatch'),
      ('no-recheck', source.replace('if (!source_same(&before, &after) || !source_same(&before, &current))', 'if (0)'), b'concurrency guard failed')]:

        run('negative-'+name+'-build',command)
        p=run('negative-'+name,[str(binary)], expected=-6)
        assert marker in p.stderr, (name,p.stderr)
    p=run('negative-noop', ['python3','tests/test_edit_delete_line.py','--program','/usr/bin/true','DeleteLineTests.test_middle_line_staged'], expected=1)
    assert b"b'first\\nsecond\\nthird\\n' != b'first\\nthird\\n'" in p.stderr
    changed=source.replace('if (line == number)\n                found = 1;', 'if (line == number) {\n                found = 1;\n                if (byte == \'\\n\' && stage_append(output, &byte, 1) != 0)\n                    return -1;\n            }')
    assert changed != source
    mutant=scratch/'retained-lf.c'; mutant.write_text(changed)
    binary=scratch/'retained-lf'
    run('negative-retained-lf-build', compile_base+['-o',str(binary),str(root/'src/edit_delete_line_main.c'),str(mutant),str(root/'src/cmd_lines.c'),'-L'+str(root/'build/argtable3/lib'),'-largtable3','-lm'])
    p=run('negative-retained-lf',['python3','tests/test_edit_delete_line.py','--program',str(binary),'DeleteLineTests.test_middle_line_staged'],expected=1)
    assert b"b'first\\n\\nthird\\n' != b'first\\nthird\\n'" in p.stderr
    print('six independent negative controls caught intended defects')
elif mode == 'trace':
    import shutil
    assert shutil.which('strace')
    fixture=scratch/'trace-fixture'; fixture.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (fixture/'file').write_bytes(b'old\r\nkeep\n')
    p=run('syscall-trace', ['strace','-yy','-e','trace=openat,read,write,fsync,close,rename,unlink','-o',str(scratch/'trace.log'),str(root/'build/edit-delete-line'),'file','1'],cwd=fixture)
    trace=(scratch/'trace.log').read_text()
    print(trace)
    assert (fixture/'file').read_bytes() == b'keep\n'
    lines=trace.split('\n')
    stage_open=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if 'O_EXCL' in l and '.edit-delete-line-' in l)
    stage_write=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('write(') and '.edit-delete-line-' in l)
    sync=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('fsync('))
    stage_close=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('close(') and '.edit-delete-line-' in l)
    rename=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('rename('))
    assert stage_open < stage_write < sync < stage_close < rename
    assert not any(l.startswith('write(') and '/trace-fixture/file>' in l for l in lines)
    assert not any('O_TRUNC' in l or 'unlink("file")' in l for l in lines)
    assert not list(fixture.glob('.edit-delete-line-*'))
    print('exclusive complete stage write/sync/close before rename; no original write/truncation')
